q: Which type of bank is owned and controlled by the Government of India?
exp: Public Sector Banks are owned by Government of India

q: What is the type of bank which is owned and controlled by its customers?
exp: Cooperative Bank is owned and controlled by its customers

q: Which type of bank is owned and controlled by private investors?
exp: Private Sector Banks are owned by private investors

q: What is the type of bank which has subsidiaries of foreign banks?
exp: Foreign Banks have subsidiaries in India

q: Which type of bank has branches in various states of the country?
exp: Public Sector Banks have presence in various states

q: What is the type of bank which is owned and controlled by a group of people in a village?
exp: Cooperative Bank is owned by village group

q: Which type of bank is owned and controlled by the Government of India after nationalization?
exp: Nationalized Banks are owned by Government of India

q: What is the type of bank which provides banking services to its shareholders only?
exp: Private Sector Banks provide services to shareholders

q: Which type of bank is owned and controlled by a group of people in a specific area?
exp: Cooperative Bank is owned by local group

q: What is the type of bank which has its own equity capital?
exp: Private Sector Banks have own equity capital

q: Which type of bank is owned and controlled by the Government of India and RBI?
exp: Public Sector Banks are owned by Government and RBI

q: What is the type of bank which has its own savings accounts?
exp: Savings Bank provides its own savings accounts

q: Which type of bank is owned and controlled by RBI?
exp: RBI controls and regulates Cooperative Banks

q: What is the type of bank which has a mix of public and private ownership?
exp: Public-Private Partnership Bank has mixed ownership

q: Which type of bank is owned and controlled by a group of villages?
exp: Cooperative Bank is owned by village group

q: What is the type of bank which has its own deposits?
exp: Savings Bank has its own deposits
